name: GMO Financial Holdings, Inc.
summary: GMO Financial Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, offers financial product and crypto asset trading services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Securities and FX Business; and Crypto Asset Business segments. It provides online securities trading and FX and cryptocurrency trading services, as well as involved in medical platform businesses, system-related businesses, etc. GMO Financial Holdings, Inc. was formerly known as GMO CLICK Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to GMO Financial Holdings, Inc. in October 2017.
